cases.name: clickable
cases.when: actionsEnabled is false or absent -- the chip root itself renders as <button>

cases.name: clickable-with-actions
cases.when: actionsEnabled is true -- a kebab cannot nest inside a button, so the root becomes a <div> and the interactive attributes move down to the chip BODY, a descendant <button>

reason: The chip is a button in both of its shapes, unconditionally: R6 in contracts/api/README.md forbids deriving a render from whether a listener is bound, so "is (click) bound?" is not a question this component may ask. It is the OPPOSITE resolution from the one TableRow's binding records, on purpose. TableRow renders the non-interactive shape because always-a-button would put a dead tab stop on every row of every table; a chip is tabindex="-1" and is never a page tab stop, so always-a-button costs no dead stop here, where always-a-div would delete Enter-into-the-chip -- the whole keyboard story arena-calendar's `grid` binding leans on. The consequence is real and bounded: a chip whose consumer bound nothing is announced as a button that does nothing, and it is reachable only by Enter from the hour cell it overlaps, never by Tab.
